title: Raenest acquires 100% stake in UK payments firm Remitise to strengthen global operations
article_text:
Global financial platform Raenest has acquired UK-based payments company Remitise, strengthening its presence in the United Kingdom as part of its international expansion strategy. title: Court strikes out EFCC’s N6bn money laundering charge against Mompha
article_text:
The court ruled that the EFCC's decision to prosecute the defendants while a related case was pending before the Federal High Court amounted to an abuse of court process.
